ApiEntityKind.description: What the admin api adds to an entity it answers

kind.description: The group and the kind of the entity, for instance `proxy.otoroshi.io/Route`. It is ignored when the entity is sent back

ErrorResponse.description: An error answered by the admin api

error.description: The error, as a short code or as a message

error_description.description: What went wrong: a message, the messages of the validation, or the errors of the fields that could not be read

kind.description: The group and the kind of the entity the call was about

Otoroshi-Error.description: The error, when the call is refused before reaching the admin api: missing or wrong credentials, exceeded quotas

FieldErrors.description: The fields of an entity that could not be read, by path (`obj.<path>`, `obj` for the entity itself)

kind.description: The group and the kind of the entity the call was about, added by the admin api to the errors it answers

msg.description: The message keys of the error, like `error.path.missing` (the field is absent) or `error.expected.jsstring` (the field does not hold a string)

args.description: The arguments of the message keys, like the expected value of a constraint. Usually empty

BadEntityResponse.description: Why an entity was refused: an error, or the errors of the fields that could not be read

EntityCount.description: The answer of the `_count` operation of an entity: how many entities of the kind the credentials can read

count.description: The number of entities the credentials can read

kind.description: The group and the kind of the entities counted

JsonSchema.description: A json schema. The schemas it references are under its `components.schemas` field

JsonPatch.description: A json patch (RFC 6902): the operations to apply, in order

JsonPatchOperation.description: An operation of a json patch (RFC 6902)

op.description: What the operation does (RFC 6902): `add`, `remove` or `replace` the value at `path`, `move` or `copy` the value at `from` to `path`, or `test` that the value at `path` equals `value`

path.description: The json pointer (RFC 6901) of the value the operation applies to

from.description: The json pointer of the value to move or to copy, for the `move` and `copy` operations

value.description: The value to add, to replace with, or to test, for the `add`, `replace` and `test` operations

FieldsPatch.description: The fields to change and their new value. A value given as a string is read as json when it is `null`, `true`, `false`, a number, an object or an array

items.description: A field and its new value

path.description: The path of the field to change, its keys separated by dots (`frontend.domains`, `metadata.owner`). The objects missing along the path are created

value.description: The new value of the field, replacing the current one. A string holding `null`, `true`, `false`, a number, a json object or a json array is read as that json value

oneOf.description: A string, read as json when it is one

FormPatch.description: The fields to change, by dotted path, and their new value. A value is read as json when it is `null`, `true`, `false`, a number, an object or an array

additionalProperties.description: The new value of the field

BulkOperationOutcome.description: The outcome of a line of a bulk operation

BulkOperationResult.description: An entity processed by a bulk operation

status.description: The http status of the operation on this entity

id.description: The id of the entity created, updated or deleted, read from the field named by `id_field`

id_field.description: The field holding the id of the entity

BulkOperationError.description: A line a bulk operation refused

status.description: The http status the line would get as a single call: 404 when the entity to update does not exist, the status of the refusal when the validation of the entity refused it, 400 otherwise (a line that cannot be read, an entity the credentials cannot change, an entity to patch or to delete that does not exist)

error.description: The error, as a short code, like `bad_entity`, or `bad_request` when the validation of the entity refused it

error_description.description: Why the line was refused: a message, the messages of the validation, the errors of the fields that could not be read, or the error of the lookup of the entity

oneOf.description: The errors of the fields that could not be read, or the error of the lookup

entity.description: The line refused. For a bulk patch whose entity is not found, the patch of the line
